Alice (Support): FYI customer Sam reported a sharp increase in 5xxs after this morning's deploy around 09:12 UTC. They see ~12-15% error rate on text-generation endpoints.
Raj (SRE): Can you paste any request IDs and example timestamps? Any auth failures or just gateway 502/504?
Alice (Support): Sent one: req=01F3X2ZQ - 09:18:02 UTC - response 502. Another: req=01F3Y5AB - 09:19:11 UTC - 504. Customer says some requests time out and others get immediate 502s.
Sam (Customer): Confirming — started about 09:15 after your deploy. No change on our side. Some short requests fail, longer ones sometimes time out.
Marta (Eng): Noticed the canary included a PREFETCH window tweak and a route-selector tweak (seed-weight change). Deploy ID: deploy/2026-03-18-09:10 canary-a.
deploy-bot: deploy/2026-03-18-09:10 started by marta — canary (10%) -> rollout planned.
Evan (Infra): Telemetry: backend latency jumped at 09:15 and the shedder started rejecting connections. kvcache miss ratio spiked for a subset of kernels.
Raj (SRE): Any config flags toggled? Prefetch change could hit memory/kv cache behavior, causing unexpected timeouts under burst.
Marta (Eng): Yeah PREFETCH_WINDOW increased from 64->128 for canary. We expected higher hit-rate but maybe caused larger batched KV lookups and longer critical sections.
Alice (Support): Customer is asking for ETA. They've queued production traffic and are seeing billing hits. Can we do an immediate rollback for canary?
Raj (SRE): I recommend pausing rollout and rolling back canary to previous config. Marta, can you initiate rollback? Also capturing logs from the failing router and auth proxy.
Marta (Eng): Rolling back now. /rollout rollback deploy/2026-03-18-09:10 canary-a -> previous stable.
deploy-bot: rollback started for deploy/2026-03-18-09:26 by marta; target traffic shift to stable.
Evan (Infra): After rollback started, 5xx started trending down within 2 minutes on the affected slice. Still seeing a few stragglers from queued requests.
Sam (Customer): We're seeing error rate drop to ~1% now, thanks. Will continue to monitor for next 30 mins.
Raj (SRE): Good — please collect a small repro corpus (request IDs and payload examples) and we will run offline against canary to reproduce the kvcache/timeout pattern.
Marta (Eng): I'll run a local A/B repro with PREFETCH_WINDOW=128 vs 64, and enable per-request tracing. Also check kernel selection: kernel-path v2 was used for some model variants.
Alice (Support): I'll update the customer and open a ticket for billing compensation if they ask. Also pinging CS for follow-up.
Evan (Infra): Action items: 1) Capture router traces + shedder logs for 09:12-09:30. 2) Run repro with canary flags against mirrored traffic. 3) Hold PREFETCH_WINDOW change behind a staged experiment + telemetry guard.
Marta (Eng): Agreed — will add canary guard to block rollout if shedder reject rate > 2% for 5m. Will follow up with PR and link here.
Alice (Support): Thanks all. Sam let me know if anything new pops up and I'll continue the handoff.
Sam (Customer): Appreciated the quick rollback and updates :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: rollback complete at 09:28, traffic restored to stable.
